target: deterministic, declared EB/EnergyPlus reference-world consequences for assigned-role judgments
nominal_hardware: original pinned EB capacity/COP/fan/flow/PLF, fixed wet-device programs, 60kWh/7.4kW/.92 EV and native tank/mixing topology preserved

temperature_curves.method: original biquadratic modifiers evaluated by pinned EnergyPlus bound clipping
temperature_curves.fit_or_manufacturer_data_origin: unknown beyond pinned original EB model; no fitted-domain/OEM transport validation claimed
temperature_curves.actual_outside_bound_use: must record raw pre-clipping inputs by coil; automatic AHRI ratings are a distinct category
temperature_curves.admissible_claim: computed electricity/air temperature under the explicitly bounded reference model
temperature_curves.production_result_policy: outside-bound records remain in benchmark with visible model-boundary scope; never relabel domain pass, suppress warning or select new dates
temperature_curves.sensitivity: original50 fixed first summer dates; unit temperature modifiers as a declared model-form diagnostic, preserving nominal parameters; not a fitted replacement or confidence interval

wet_devices.strategy: noninterruptible reference program with explicit loading/ready/unloading states; cancellation before start; no automatic retries
wet_devices.manufacturer_scope: Miele WTD160 manual confirms lock plus explicit pause/cancel conditions; does not validate universal noninterruptibility of all washers/dishwashers
wet_devices.service: batch handover/crockery inventory requirements precede A; clean or wearable status not inferred from power alone

EV.meter: actual EP charging circuit energy; analytic efficiency/storage and realized trip debit
EV.meaning: given access and traction/reserve contracts; no preference or national commute identification
EV.failed_trip: no traction delivered; alternate travel and actor rescheduling unknown
EV.causal_authority: one shared resource/event ledger; successful departure alone defines vehicle absence; manual handling and charging cannot use a conflicting planned-absence calendar

heating.claim: conditioned external heating boundary, not complete household all-fuel energy

window.tail: finite service tail; terminal tank/air/SOC differences retained

required_checks: continuous A delivery and pre-notice equality
same original50 7/14-day prior and fixed/seasonal inlet
actual curve boundary usage and model-form sensitivity
wetbulb strict point failure preserved; same-phase residual/bounds separately checked
production_scope_before_original50_readb: reference inputs only; physical results remain pending
result_reuse: exact IDF,weather,engine,SQL hashes plus preserved old receipt; current ledgers independently reread; old acceptance never copied
power_limit_semantics: maximum 10-minute average meter power; reference planning boundary, not instantaneous starting current or protection certification
